text: Plot 3 stands out a little because the top blue box is noticeably wider than most of the others, showing a smaller spread in the main cluster. The whiskers also longer making the overall distribution look more stretched out. I would also say Plot 20 because the box, the red box is much wider and denser than most of the lineup, while the blue box is also unusually narrow.
